products.title: Floor Lamp - SuperWire
products.description_html:
SuperWire is the first family of modular lamps designed by Formafantasma for Flos. A magical and poetic project, with an essential design but a great stage presence, which recalls the work of the great glass masters of the last century. Made of planar glass and polished aluminum, its design originated from the development of a custom-made light source that emits a warm and homogeneous light.Made up of one or more hexagons of planar glass connected by a polished aluminum element, SuperWire lights up its entire surface thanks to a new source: a very thin, flat, soft, flexible LED strip measuring up to one meter, which emits a warm and homogeneous light along its entire length and which can be easily removed for replacement and repair, unique in the panorama of LED bulb-less lamps.This floor version, is built with two 75 cm high modules, placed one above the other, resting on a steel tripod, a tribute to the historic Luminator by the Castiglioni brothers.

products.title: Floor Lamp - Seki-Han - wood
products.description_html:
Floor lamp emitting direct and indirect light with symmetrical and asymmetrical distribution. Features two vertical ash wood blades joined by chromed metal fittings. Blades rotate around a central tubular light source to allow variable light emission. Raw black iron base separated from the vertical blades by a collar. Custom-developed dimmable linear LED light source. The lamp can also be fitted with standard T8 LED tubes.Designed by Tobia Scarpa in 1963 and reissued in 2025, Seki-Han is testament to his mastery of design and wood-working expertise. The intricate construction draws on naval techniques to shape two wooden blades that now rotate around the light source. Even when almost completely closed, a sliver of light remains visible, creating a highly poetic effect. Named after a traditional Japanese rice dish served on special occasions, Seki-Han is a living presence where the immateriality of light meets the tactility of wood.

products.title: Floor Lamp - Chiara - Stainless Steel
products.description_html:
The FLOS Chiara Floor Lamp is a 2020 design and a reissue of Mario Bellini's original 1969 icon. The story behind this unique lamp begins when Bellini realises that light can be used in the same way it manifests itself in our environment: never directly, but through reflection on surfaces. The designer took a pair of scissors and a piece of cardboard and began cutting something that could be made into a cylinder with a wide cap. When the left and right sides of the cap were joined together, it would function as a reflector for the cylindrical base. Although the Italian name Chiara means “clear”, the name of the lamp refers to certain dialect expressions in Lombardy for “casting light”, translated into the Italian word “Chiaro”.

Fifty years after the introduction of the original Chiara, FLOS is reissuing the classic in new sizes and finishes. With its large size, the floor lamp is a stunning sight to behold; soft in shape and impressive in presence. The lamp has a reflective profile made of laser-cut stainless steel and is finished on the inside with a white plastic film. The folded surface is closed by hooks formed directly from the sheet metal. A coloured seal made of moulded thermoplastic polyurethane runs along the entire profile of the lamp. The supplied 190-centimetre cord has a dimmer switch that allows you to adjust the light intensity to your liking. The light source is not included.
